entities.name: Trifon
entities.description: Amphibious marine troll of Ravnica, speaker for Zonot Four, who quashes dissent with brute force.

entities.name: Zonot Four

entities.name: Zonot Three

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Figure Trifon lent his full support to.
